units.source_text: 六条院中忙着准备小女公子入宫之时，夕雾中将心事满腹，神思恍惚，

en.t: While everyone at Rokujo-in was busy preparing for the young lady's entry into court, Lieutenant General Yugiri was full of anxious thoughts and moved about in a daze,

units.source_text: 但又觉得奇怪：“我自己也不知道，我心何以如此固执。

en.t: yet he also found it strange: "I myself do not know why my heart is so stubborn.

units.source_text: 相思既然如此其苦，则现在对方已经让步，

en.t: Since longing for each other is so painful, and now the other side has already yielded,

units.source_text: ‘守关者’已经‘睡熟’，

en.t: the gatekeeper has already fallen fast asleep,

units.source_text: 反正只要等候对方正式前来议婚好了，何必多忧呢？”

en.t: so surely I only need to wait for them to come formally to discuss the marriage. Why should I worry so much?"

units.source_text: 他耐心等候，颇感痛苦，心情烦乱之极。

en.t: He waited patiently, but suffered greatly, and his mind was in utter turmoil.

units.source_text: 云居雁也在想：“那天父亲悄悄地告我之言，

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was also thinking, "If the words my father secretly told me that day

units.source_text: 如果成了事实，则夕雾势必把我完全忘却。”

en.t: should come true, then Yugiri will surely forget me completely."

units.source_text: 她不胜悲伤。

en.t: She was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 这两人虽然由于乖运而互相背离，但毕竟是一对不可分离的恋人。

en.t: Although these two had been driven apart by ill fortune, they were after all lovers who could not be separated.

units.source_text: 至于内大臣呢，态度如此强硬，但对自己全无好处，心中不胜烦恼。

en.t: As for the Minister of the Interior, he had taken such a hard line, yet it brought him no benefit at all, and he was deeply troubled at heart.

units.source_text: 他想：“如果中务亲王招了夕雾为婿，则我的女儿只得另行择人。

en.t: He thought, "If Prince Nakatsukasa takes Yugiri as his son-in-law, then my daughter will have no choice but to choose someone else.

units.source_text: 如此夕雾实甚痛苦；而我们亦必被人耻笑。

en.t: That would be truly painful for Yugiri, and we too would certainly be laughed at.

units.source_text: 自然不免发生有伤体面之事。

en.t: Naturally, something damaging to our dignity would be unavoidable.

units.source_text: 虽然十分秘密，但是家丑早已外扬。

en.t: Although we have kept it very secret, the family's disgrace has already spread outside.

units.source_text: 想来想去，还不如设法调解，自动让步。”

en.t: The more I think about it, the better it would be to find some way to reconcile matters and yield of my own accord."

units.source_text: 内大臣和夕雾，外表若无其事，而心中仇恨不解。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior and Yugiri appeared outwardly as if nothing were wrong, but inwardly their resentment remained unresolved.

units.source_text: 突然向夕雾说亲，内大臣觉得不好意思；

en.t: The Minister of the Interior felt awkward about suddenly proposing the marriage to Yugiri;

units.source_text: 而郑重其事地迎接新婿，又恐外人取笑。

en.t: yet if he formally welcomed him as a new son-in-law, he feared outsiders would laugh at him.

units.source_text: 因此他想等候适当机会，隐约向夕雾示意。

en.t: Therefore he decided to wait for a suitable opportunity and hint his intentions to Yugiri indirectly.
